title: Pulsed Evidence Bundles: modular PDF/CSV manifests with residency-aware routing
creator: Marco Rivera
description: Provide a tenant-configurable 'pulsed' export capability that emits periodic, incremental compliance bundles (PDF/CSV + manifest) with residency-aware routing, selective redaction, and multiple delivery sinks (S3, signed download, webhook). This feature addresses enterprise customer asks for automated evidence snapshots on an SLA schedule, with compact deltas between pulses and clear provenance manifests for auditors.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can create a pulsed export policy specifying cadence (daily/weekly/monthly), target residency region, retention window for the bundle, and delivery sink(s)
Export payloads support PDF summary + CSV raw rows, plus a machine-readable JSON manifest describing included evidence, tenant ID, region tag, and signature checksum
Policy enforces residency: bundles for EU-only customers can only be staged and delivered from EU regions; cross-region delivery should be blocked unless explicitly allowed in tenant settings
Selective redaction config allows per-field patterns to be masked in CSV and a redaction summary to appear in the PDF
Bundles support delta mode: first pulse is full, subsequent pulses include only new evidence and a delta manifest linking back to previous bundle IDs
Delivery reliability: retries with exponential backoff for webhooks, signed URL generation for object stores, and alerting on sustained failures (>3 consecutive misses)
Audit trail visible in Console: each bundle has status, bytes, record counts, last delivery attempt, and link to the manifest and raw artifacts
notes: We need to balance bundle size (cost) vs auditor expectations for full context. Proposal: default to delta mode with an option to include N previous pulses for context.
Consider integrating existing residency routing code from the export-orchestrator; engineering estimate assumes reusing region routing and signing libraries.
PDF generation should be offloaded to a serverless job to avoid blocking runtime pools; use HTML-to-PDF with company branding and a canonical summary table.
Retention policy: bundles inherit tenant retention+export retention; admin may override per-export with an upper bound set by org compliance policy
deployment_plan: Phase 1: API + manifest schema + S3 signed delivery (MVP)
Phase 2: PDF templating + delta bundles + residency enforcement
Phase 3: UI for policy creation + webhook delivery + retry observability
risk_and_mitigation: Large tenants may produce very large bundles — mitigation: enforce chunking and recommend delta mode; expose estimated size prior to first run.
Residency misconfiguration risk — mitigation: block cross-region delivery by default and surface warnings in Console with a two-step consent flow for exceptions.
PII leakage from CSV exports — mitigation: validate redaction regexes at policy save and run a dry-run scanner for common sensitive fields before first delivery.

2025-07-12 Lydia Chen (Legal): Asked to include canonical notarization metadata (signer, timestamp, hash). Recommend RSA SHA256 signature on manifest.
2025-07-13 Rajiv Menon (SRE): Noted that PDF generation on runtime nodes caused OOM in a past initiative; plan to run conversion in a dedicated serverless fleet.
